scientific_integrity: Analytical sign and topological arguments support the theorem, and exact symbolic checks reproduce the example. Literature priority is not exhaustively established; no independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The universal positive result assumes continuous nonnegative contact responses, strictly positive link-equilibrium denominators, and positive creation on every directed infection edge at prevalence vectors with all coordinates below one. The negative example uses a C2 cubic-hinge response with zero creation beyond a threshold. No uniqueness or stability claim is made for the positive-creation general theorem; the two-group boundary equilibrium is proved locally stable, not globally attracting.
title: A supercritical adaptive epidemic can have only a boundary endemic state
